addr: 2H2C+95H, E Park Rd, Malleshwaram, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560003, India

rev.t: Large function hall in the heart of Malleswaram with parking is heavenly!!! Plus point is the elevator goes till last floor- dining hall, which is very helpful for elderly people.

This is a Hindu religious place where rituals are performed. The surrounding area has very good temples and very serene.This place is quite big and well maintained with lifts available to reach 3 floors..I wish they had more washrooms ..
Good place for small marriage and party functions.  Getting 4 wheeler parking in Malleswaram is difficult part
